The '''1995-96 [[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]] season''' saw 18 teams in competition. [[Fenerbahçe S.K.]] won the championship. The season was notable for [[Graeme Souness]]'s season-long cameo as the manager of [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray]].
